name: @modelcontextprotocol/server-sqlite
description: Official Model Context Protocol server for SQLite databases. Exposes schema inspection, SQL queries, and table operations.

tools.name: sqlite_read_query
tools.description: Execute a SELECT query on the SQLite database.

tools.name: sqlite_list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in the SQLite database.

tools.name: sqlite_describe_table
tools.description: Get column definitions and schema information for a specific table.

table_name.description: Name of the table to describe

tools.name: sqlite_create_table
tools.description: Create a new table in the database schema.
